items.title: Terry Clark — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: he and I were good buddies. We were – played in Duke’s band together.

ctx.x: So you don’t have much of a recollection of him.
No. His cousin Wendall Marshall, who still owns Blanton’s bass – he and I were good buddies. We were – played in Duke’s band together.
Did you know Wendall – was Wendall from St. Louis as well?
